mapper.select: select t.value_source as valueSource, t.curve_code as curveCode, t.remark as curveName, t.int_curve_type as intCurveType, 'CNY' as ccy, '线性插值' as interMethod, 'A/365' as dayRules, '银行间交易日历' as calender, '起息日向后' as interestDateRule, '按年复利' as interestCalMethod, '年付' as interestFreq/*, eff_status as effStatus*/ from MST_CURVE_DEF t where t.curve_code = #{curveCode} and rownum=1
